issues.text: context.agent_run_id is filled by ORCH (aa5023fb0e8733e4c); this step continues the launch of steps 01, 01c and 01e.

Remaining ways to defeat the lock precondition (design section 14, named, not closed): (1) a holder that names the file by a word and not a path («the state file», «the top block», «STATE» without .md) or a parent folder written without its «/» («docs» alone) — a bare folder word is not read as a folder, so that common words like «tools» do not lock; (2) a misspelled path («State.md», letters of another script) or a glob of another form than * and ** («{a,b}.md», «[A-Z]*.md»); (3) a writer that is not a PENDING or IN_PROGRESS handoff (a person, a process outside the protocol, a handoff marked done whose agent still writes); (4) a handoff whose task names the file but whose write_set does not — only write_set is read. One over-match on the safe side stays: a folder with an extension-like name before the file («docs/x.v2/PLAN.md» holds PLAN.md).

Check (6) still cannot see a program requirement that has no row at all in the PROGRESS P-code table (it was «a requirement numbered below REQ-102» before). Today REQ-110 (R0.2) has no row with its REQ id; when its gate passes ORCH appends its form row and its PLAN.md line (6.1), and (6) then asks for that row.

The token form finds 31 real holders that the substring form of pass 2 did not (parent folders such as «decisions/», «ideas/», «tools/test/», globs such as «tools/test/*.js», the locked folder «docs/issues» without its «/»); none of them is PENDING or IN_PROGRESS today, so no lock waits longer now. Three of them come from the words «… in tools/» of an item (an over-match on the safe side).

The earlier mutant series ran with the background option of the tool; I waited for its end line «BATCH END» (a Monitor on its output file) and started nothing on the trial meanwhile (AP-157). Long command texts went into files in <scratch>/m0docs-01/bin4/; the node tests had TMPDIR in the session folder.

No command was denied by the permission check. Nothing was committed, pushed, tagged or branched; no checkout, reset, stash or clean; Pixel Office, the team server and the real claude were not started; SAI_TEAM_REAL_RUNS was not set. Only the design file (and this handoff) changed in the project.
